hebrewText: וַֽ/יְבַשְּׁל֥וּ הַ/פֶּ֛סַח בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ/הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֣ים בִּשְּׁל֗וּ בַּ/סִּיר֤וֹת וּ/בַ/דְּוָדִים֙ וּ/בַ/צֵּ֣לָח֔וֹת וַ/יָּרִ֖יצוּ לְ/כָל בְּנֵ֥י הָ/עָֽם

tokens.bdb: properly, to boil up; hence, to be done in cooking; figuratively to ripen
tokens.kjv: bake, boil, bring forth, roast, seethe, sod (be sodden).

tokens.bdb: a pretermission, i.e. exemption; used only techically of the Jewish Passover (the festival or the victim)

properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
tokens.kjv: [phrase] adversary, ceremony, charge, [idiom] crime, custom, desert, determination, discretion, disposing, due, fashion, form, to be judged, judgment, just(-ice, -ly), (manner of) law(-ful), manner, measure, (due) order, ordinance, right, sentence, usest, [idiom] worthy, [phrase] wrong.

tokens.bdb: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
tokens.kjv: consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, ([idiom] most) holy ([idiom] day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.

tokens.enLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanation: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanationEn: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract

tokens.kjv: bake, boil, bring forth, roast, seethe, sod (be sodden).

tokens.bdb: a pot; also a thorn (as springing up rapidly); by implication, a hook

tokens.bdb: a pot (for boiling); also (by resemblance of shape) a basket
something protracted or flattened out, i.e. a platter
to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush)
tokens.kjv: break down, divide speedily, footman, guard, bring hastily, (make) run (away, through), post.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum
